title: The Peacock Throne: The Shah Who Emptied Delhi
summary: Tells how the Persian ruler Nadir Shah scattered the Mughal army at Karnal in seventeen thirty-nine in a matter of hours, then entered Delhi, sacked the city, and carried off a treasure that included the Peacock Throne and the Koh-i-Noor. The episode covers how that single campaign turned the Mughal Empire into a hollow shell and opened India to new masters.
